title: Software factory configuration (factory.json, versioned; read by cmd/factory, not by a2dlc)
description: How cmd/factory runs the lanes of a batch (ADR meta/0008): which role image and which claude flags a lane uses, how many lanes run at once, and the caps. The six spend and lane caps are required: there is no default, so a run states what it may spend. caps.run_wall_seconds is optional. Constraints that JSON Schema cannot compare are checked by cmd/factory before it starts: caps.lane_usd <= caps.run_kill_usd, caps.run_stop_new_usd <= caps.run_kill_usd, caps.run_kill_usd <= caps.total_usd, network provider requires egress_allow. The lane is `a2dlc run --mode lite` over a worktree with builder_primary as the only role; the factory writes that roles.json from this file, and the model is called only through unmodified `claude -p` with the flags below.

roles_image.description: Image with the claude CLI and roles/adapter.py (a2dlc-roles:<tag>). Same pattern as roles.schema.json.

env_file.description: Local path outside the repo with the credential, passed to docker with --env-file. The factory never reads it.

network.description: roles.schema.json network. A lane that calls claude needs provider.

egress_allow.description: Hostnames the egress proxy lets a provider lane reach.

model.description: claude --model for every lane of the run (A2DLC_MODEL). A run never changes model midway.

tools.description: The bounded tool list passed as claude --tools.

arm.description: Which arm of the preregistered comparison the run is. Absent means minimal (arm 1), the claude flags of `tools` above. control (arm 0) is default `claude -p` in the same role container: none of those flags, so `tools` is read but not passed; the only flag it keeps is --max-budget-usd, which enforces the lane cap every arm shares. The hash of this file is in the report, so the arm of a run cannot be changed afterwards.

lane_usd.description: A lane launches no model call once it has spent this much; each call also gets the lane's remaining budget as claude --max-budget-usd.

lane_seconds.description: Wall time of a lane; the role container is killed when it runs out.

lane_turns.description: Model turns a lane may use over all its calls, from the turns each call reports. claude has no --max-turns, so the core checks it before each launch; one call can overshoot it.

run_stop_new_usd.description: No new lane starts once the run has spent this much.

run_kill_usd.description: Every lane in flight is killed once the run has spent this much.

total_usd.description: Ceiling over all runs in the output directory: earlier reports' spend plus this run's. Reaching it kills the run.

run_wall_seconds.description: Optional. Wall time of the whole run, from the first lane to the last. Once it has passed no new lane starts and every lane in flight is killed; the report records it in killed_by with the elapsed seconds. Absent means the run has no wall-time cap (the lane caps still apply). Added after the six required caps, so earlier configs stay valid.
